sharing.title: Share data
sharing.lead: You can only share with an existing VitaScan account. Diary, weight, water, body measurements and body fat are visible live from acceptance — past history is not included. Shopping lists and the meal plan are collaborative. Logging a planned meal always writes to your own diary. Your partner sees Shared; you see Sharing on your lists.
